title: Zebra holding a heart
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Zebra body -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="68" rx="24" ry="17" fill="#E8E8F0"/>
  <!-- Zebra stripes on body -->
  <path d="M34 60 Q40 58 46 61" stroke="#5A5A7A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M32 68 Q40 66 48 69" stroke="#5A5A7A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M34 76 Q42 74 50 77" stroke="#5A5A7A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M56 58 Q62 61 68 59" stroke="#5A5A7A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M54 68 Q62 70 70 68" stroke="#5A5A7A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M52 77 Q58 74 66 76" stroke="#5A5A7A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="38" y="82" width="6" height="12" rx="3" fill="#D0D0E0"/>
  <rect x="48" y="82" width="6" height="12" rx="3" fill="#D0D0E0"/>
  <rect x="58" y="82" width="6" height="12" rx="3" fill="#D0D0E0"/>
  <rect x="66" y="82" width="6" height="12" rx="3" fill="#D0D0E0"/>

  <!-- Leg hooves -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="94" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#5A5A7A"/>
  <ellipse cx="51" cy="94" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#5A5A7A"/>
  <ellipse cx="61" cy="94" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#5A5A7A"/>
  <ellipse cx="69" cy="94" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#5A5A7A"/>

  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d="M36 56 Q30 40 34 30 L44 32 Q40 42 44 56 Z" fill="#E8E8F0"/>
  <!-- Neck stripes -->
  <path d="M34 50 Q38 47 42 50" stroke="#5A5A7A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M33 42 Q37 39 41 42" stroke="#5A5A7A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M33 34 Q37 31 41 34" stroke="#5A5A7A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="22" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#E8E8F0"/>

  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="12" rx="4" ry="7" transform="rotate(-20 26 12)" fill="#E8E8F0"/>
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="12" rx="2" ry="4.5" transform="rotate(-20 26 12)" fill="#F0A0B0"/>
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="11" rx="4" ry="7" transform="rotate(15 44 11)" fill="#E8E8F0"/>
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="11" rx="2" ry="4.5" transform="rotate(15 44 11)" fill="#F0A0B0"/>

  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="28" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#F0C0D0"/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx="27" cy="27" r="1.5" fill="#7A5A7A"/>
  <circle cx="33" cy="27" r="1.5" fill="#7A5A7A"/>

  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="19" r="4" fill="#5A5A7A"/>
  <circle cx="41.5" cy="17.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Mane -->
  <path d="M42 13 Q50 16 44 22 Q50 24 44 28 Q48 31 42 35" stroke="#5A5A7A" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Arms holding heart -->
  <path d="M64 66 Q74 60 72 50" stroke="#D0D0E0" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M68 66 Q78 62 76 52" stroke="#D0D0E0" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Heart -->
  <g transform="translate(74, 42)">
    <path d="M0 6 C-1 -2 -10 -2 -10 6 C-10 14 0 20 0 22 C0 20 10 14 10 6 C10 -2 1 -2 0 6 Z" fill="#FF3060" stroke="#FF7090" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="-3" cy="5" rx="2.5" ry="2" fill="#FF90A8" opacity="0.7"/>
  </g>
</svg>
